lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters positioned posterior to the branchial region, organized into at least four discernible horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the circular blobs, creating a rectilinear lattice pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a distinct luminance transition from light dorsal pixels to darker lateral pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct smaller silhouettes consistent with commensal fish are attached to the posterior margin of the right pectoral fin.
